models.name: Flux.1 Schnell
models.default_positive: photorealistic, natural light, 50mm, shallow depth of field, film grain
models.default_negative: low saturation, blur, watermark, jpeg artifacts
models.placeholder: photorealistic portrait of a young woman by the window, soft natural light, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain

tips.text: Flux 模型 CFG 建议 3~4，过高会过饱和——超过 5 基本就是硬边 + 糊色
负面词保持轻量：Flux 对重负面词敏感，堆长串会掉饱和度、丢细节
Schnell 是蒸馏模型，20 步已经到顶；加到 30 步只多耗时

models.name: SDXL 1.0
models.default_positive: masterpiece, best quality, detailed skin texture, cinematic lighting
models.default_negative: (deformed, distorted, disfigured:1.3), poorly drawn, bad anatomy, wrong anatomy, extra limb, missing limb, floating limbs, mutated hands, watermark, signature, text
models.placeholder: masterpiece, best quality, a young woman in beige knitwear by the window, cinematic lighting, detailed skin texture

tips.text: 要加自定义 LoRA 就选这个：生态最全，权重语法用 A1111 括号加权
负面词是带权重的 SDXL 标准串，别随意删项——手部与肢体是它的老毛病

models.name: Pony Diffusion V6
models.default_negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits
models.placeholder: 1girl, silver hair, school uniform, outdoors, cherry blossoms, looking at viewer, upper body, detailed eyes

tips.text: 二次元风格请用标签式提示词，如：1girl, silver hair, school uniform
Pony V6 用 Danbooru 标签写法；正向串建议以 score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up 开头
不要写自然语言长句——标签模型对整句的理解远弱于逗号标签

models.name: Wan 2.1 T2V
models.default_positive: cinematic camera move, natural motion, physically plausible
models.default_negative: 静态, 模糊, 抖动, 变形, 多余肢体, 水印, 文字
models.placeholder: 中式神话天庭仙境，悬浮仙山琼阁，云雾漫过殿基，仙鹤掠过前中景；镜头自云海低处缓慢前推并微微上摇，5 秒，720p
